evals.prompt: Which reporting guideline do we follow? Study: retrospective cohort using our health system's EHR (Epic Clarity extract) 2018-2024, causal aim — does early statin exposure after stroke reduce 1-year mortality. No AI involved. Not preregistered yet. Setup was already run.
evals.expected_output: Routes the study to STROBE with RECORD, writes the canonical string fields to <repo-root>/.methodsmith/config.local.yaml, drops fillable checklist placeholders under analysis/checklists/, and prints the __CE_CHECKLIST__ signal.
expectations: Selects STROBE as primary and RECORD as an extension

Writes stack_profile.reporting_checklist: STROBE (string form, not boolean) and reporting_checklist_extensions: [RECORD] to <repo-root>/.methodsmith/config.local.yaml resolved via git rev-parse --show-toplevel
Writes analysis/checklists/STROBE.md and analysis/checklists/RECORD.md as fillable checklist tables
Heads each checklist placeholder with the guideline statement's citation (PMID/DOI) confirmed through the PubMed MCP rather than an invented or unverified reference
Prints exactly one line of the form __CE_CHECKLIST__ primary=STROBE extensions=[RECORD]
Does not re-ask routing questions already answered in the prompt (design, direction, aim, AI involvement)

evals.prompt:
__CE_RESEARCH_QUESTION__ yaml=analysis/research-question.yaml design=prediction_model checklist=?

Ok the research question is locked. We're developing a gradient-boosted model to predict in-hospital deterioration from vitals and labs, then external validation at a second site. Pick the checklist(s) before I start the SAP.
evals.expected_output: Pre-fills routing answers from the research-question YAML, surfaces them for confirmation, and routes to TRIPOD+AI as primary with REFORMS as the ML-based-science extension before writing the stack profile, recording ai_involvement with a canonical value (CHARMS is not added because it applies only to systematic reviews of prediction models).
expectations: Reads analysis/research-question.yaml and surfaces pre-filled design/AI involvement/population values for user confirmation before writing to the stack profile
Routes to TRIPOD+AI as the primary checklist (prediction model with AI involvement) and does not make REFORMS the primary; REFORMS, if added, is an extension
Writes ai_involvement using only a canonical value (none, ai-assisted, ai-primary, or llm-based; here ai-primary), never model-as-study-object or model-as-tool
Does not write the SAP itself

evals.prompt: Here's our finished manuscript draft at manuscript/main.docx for the RCT of a nurse-led sepsis bundle. Score it against CONSORT and tell me which items we're missing.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes this is a review-time compliance scoring request, which this skill does not do; at most it confirms CONSORT as the applicable checklist and routes compliance scoring to review time (method-reporting-checklist-reviewer via code/document review).
expectations: Does not produce an item-by-item compliance score of the manuscript
States that checklist compliance review happens at review time (method-reporting-checklist-reviewer during code/document review)
If it identifies the checklist, names CONSORT for the RCT
